Definition: from G5557 and πράσον (a leek); a greenish-yellow gem ("chrysoprase"):--chrysoprase.
BiblicalUsage: The chrysoprase is the tenth foundation stone of the New Jerusalem, a greenish-yellow gem like a leek. John lists it without a sermon, as one stone among twelve, and the city needs every one of them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every stone in the city's wall matters, because God builds His city from the particular and the precious, not the generic.
